fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting focused on Miami politics and policing, including renewed discussion of the Huttoe/Barker incident and criticism of Miami daily newspapers for omitting or distorting facts; coverage of City Commissioner H. Leslie Quigg disputing claims of Ku Klux Klan membership and alleging press misquotation; commentary on proposals for legalized gambling/bookmaking and arguments for controlled prostitution as a response to social problems; a report criticizing Miami Transit Company bus-stop changes as favoring downtown department stores over small businesses; notes on Florida oil exploration and drilling plans (including Levy County and expected Dade County activity); and assorted local court/police-blotter items and sports notes (including Joe DiMaggio).
